title: merremia crispatula var. andamanica
intro: Merremia crispatula var. andamanica, commonly known as Andaman merremia, is a plant species within the Convolvulaceae family, native to the Andaman Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Andaman merremia include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its ability to stimulate cell growth and inhibit cell division. The bioactive constituents of Andaman merremia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
